mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation was most worthwhile because it brought the chapter's air and blood routes together and showed how a breath serves distant cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the exchange surface to the lung spaces repeated the separation and gas-direction information from the preceding result, although it did complete the structure.

surprise.text: The comparison showing that smaller sacs provide twice the surface area for the same air volume changed my understanding of why lungs have many small sacs.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but the pleural membranes' role was less clear to me until the result explained how they couple the lungs to the chest.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the connected body systems support further activity. The explanations are useful, though having only one combination available for most decisions made the play feel guided.
